unit: Integrated skill-creator package; unchanged comparative adaptation, not per-file certification or lifecycle-rubric score

criteria.name: Purpose and boundaries
criteria.basis: C0: one owner, one baseline and one verdict; creator owns selected specialist tools.

criteria.name: Domain value and context cost
criteria.basis: Distinct machinery retained; historical execution evidence excluded from runtime archive.

criteria.name: Inputs, outputs and expected outcomes
criteria.basis: C2/C4/C10: freeze before execution, optional comparison expectations, correctly decoded YAML.

criteria.name: Correctness and authority
criteria.basis: C1/C3: actual verdict-count consistency tested; hook protocol source checked; illustrative comparison reconciled.

criteria.name: Usability and discovery
criteria.basis: C7/C8: usable section maps, real Chromium names/focus behavior.

criteria.name: Failure handling and proportional controls
criteria.basis: C6/C9 and IR1-4: malformed input, archive aliases/case and required entrypoint fail safely.

criteria.name: Validation and evidence integrity
criteria.basis: C5 provenance corrected and local checks refreshed. Retain material-gap cap (11/15) for required current-revision behavioral evidence; local passes cannot fill it.

criteria.name: Package integration
criteria.basis: Producer/schema/caller contracts and 156 local links/anchors agree.

criteria.name: Maintainability
criteria.basis: C11: discovery versus loaded-body guidance scoped to providers; compatibility and refresh conditions recorded.

criteria.name: Mechanical integrity
criteria.basis: C12: repaired paths, syntax/Ruff, Markdown/JSON style, validator and eleven schema checks pass.

writing_score: Prior 97/100 unchanged; no new review of writing package
